name: Anthony All
_comment: Built from Anthony's full playlist export (all_the_music_i_know (1).csv), a superset of the Anthony deck's. Songs already in anthony.json keep its year, including the hand-corrected best-of pressings; the rest take the release date of the pressing in the export. Billie Jean 1982 and All I Want for Christmas Is You 1994 are left out so the span has no hole. Every entry is tier 1. See CLAUDE.md.
